title: A Falsified Bar-Instability Criterion Reveals an Independent Disk-State Parameter from EFC-Modified Disk Kinematics
abstract: This paper empirically tests an EFC-modified Toomre-like stability parameter ΠEFC, which augments the epicyclic frequency with an entropy-flow term, as a predictor of bar morphology in disk galaxies. The bar-onset criterion is falsified (AUC 0.22–0.31, anti-correlated with truth), but the minimum Π within the disk window strongly correlates with independent disk-state observables (negative with stellar surface density, positive with gas fraction) across SPARC and xGASS samples. Πmin is thus registered as a Stage-1 candidate disk-evolutionary-state proxy on the joint (Σ, fgas) manifold.
